title: Core: AS2 Sound class built-in methods
description: Test AS2 Sound class compilation: var s = new Sound(mc), s.attachSound('id'), s.start(offset, loops), s.stop(), s.setVolume(n), s.getVolume(), s.setPan(n), s.getPan(), s.getBytesLoaded(), s.getBytesTotal(), s.loadSound(url, isStream), s.onLoad = function(){}, s.onSoundComplete = function(){}. Each call should compile without error and emit correct ActionNew (0x4a) / ActionCallMethod (0x52) opcodes.
